Privacy & accessibility

Privacy.

The short version: this site doesn’t track you, set cookies, or collect anything about you.

Privacy

Who runs this site

davidnoh.com is the personal portfolio of David Noh. For anything on this page, write to Daviddwnoh@gmail.com.

What this site collects

Nothing. There are no accounts, forms, analytics, advertising pixels or cookies set by this site, and nothing is sold or shared, because nothing is gathered.

Hosting

The site is hosted on GitHub Pages. Like any web host, GitHub receives your IP address and basic request details in order to deliver the pages, and may keep them in server logs for security. That processing is described in the GitHub Privacy Statement.

The text typeface (Space Grotesk) is delivered by Google Fonts, so your browser contacts Google’s servers to download it when a page loads. Google receives your IP address as part of that request. See Google Fonts’ privacy notes.

A few video thumbnails are loaded directly from YouTube and Google Drive, which means your browser requests those images from that service when the page loads.

Embedded video

Films on this site are hosted on YouTube, Instagram and Google Drive. Their players are not loaded when you open a page. You see a still frame, and the player is only requested once you press play. From that moment the platform can set cookies and collect data under its own policy (Google and Instagram). YouTube videos use YouTube’s privacy-enhanced mode.

Links to Instagram, YouTube and other sites open those services directly, and their policies apply once you are there.

Email

If you email me, I use your address and message only to reply to you.

Your rights

Depending on where you live (for example under the GDPR or the CCPA) you may have the right to ask what personal data is held about you and to have it corrected or deleted. This site holds none, but you are welcome to ask, and I will answer.

Children

This site is not directed at children under 13 and does not knowingly collect information from anyone.

Credits & copyright

Films, photographs and writing here are © David Noh unless a page credits someone else. Names and logos of organizations (such as National History Day, the Scholastic Art & Writing Awards and NYU) belong to their owners and appear only to identify the work or recognition they relate to. If you appear in something here and would like it changed or removed, email me and I will take care of it.

Accessibility

What I aim for

I want this site to work for everyone, and build it against the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1, level AA: it can be used by keyboard alone, respects your reduced-motion setting, keeps text contrast readable, and nothing plays or moves on its own.

Known gaps

Some of the films are hosted on outside platforms and don’t yet have captions or transcripts. If you need one, or run into any other barrier, email Daviddwnoh@gmail.com and I will get you the content in a form that works.
